# Destroy Rendezvous

![Destroy Rendezvous function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/rendezvous/destroy.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Destroys the resource and all aliases, removes its name and ends pending waits with error and timed out=True. Executes cleanup despite an upstream error, which retains priority. Returns the name, no reference and no force option. Already committed successful cohorts retain success.

Détruit la ressource et tous ses alias, retire son nom et termine les attentes avec erreur et timed out=True. Nettoie malgré une erreur amont, qui reste prioritaire. Renvoie le nom, sans référence ni option force. Les cohortes déjà validées gardent leur succès.

## Types and connection rules

Fixed nominal RendezvousRef without payload T. Preserve exact reference class across aggregates and boundaries; reject Queue, Notifier, Semaphore and widget references.

- Type resolution: `fixed`; result expression: `declared_output_type`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: not accepted; lifting policy: `none`.

A Rendezvous is a participant barrier, not a message container. No implicit array lifting or foreign-reference conversion.

**Input count:** 2; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `rendezvous` → `error_in`.
